question: Should gateway JSON error.message and media reason fields become locale-dependent display text, or should they stay stable while localization is limited to clearly display-only surfaces?
rationale: The PR changes gateway fields that clients may consume as API responses, and repository policy treats gateway/protocol compatibility as maintainer-owned rather than something a review worker should infer from green tests.

options.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Fields Stable
options.body: Continue localizing channel/runtime display text, but keep gateway JSON message and reason strings stable unless a dedicated localized display field or documented contract is added.

options.title: Accept Localized Gateway Text
options.body: Treat the changed gateway strings as display-only and accept locale-dependent values once tests and docs make code/type fields the supported machine contract.

options.title: Split Display From Contract
options.body: Add separate localized display text while preserving existing stable fields for compatibility, at the cost of a broader gateway contract change.

recommendation.title: Keep Protocol-Facing Fields Stable
recommendation.body: Continue localizing channel/runtime display text, but keep gateway JSON message and reason strings stable unless a dedicated localized display field or documented contract is added.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the prior wizard i18n work and is the strongest available routing candidate for a runtime/gateway localization product/API decision.
